newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon Q1 oper profit flat, sees full-yr rise.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon Q1 oper profit flat, sees full-yr rise.

text.p: WIESBADEN, Germany, April 21 - German carbon and graphite manufacturer SGL Carbon AG said on Monday its operating profit in the first quarter of 1997 approximately matched the year-earlier result of 80 million marks.
Sales including acquisitions totalled about 450 million marks in the first quarter, up 10 percent, the company said.
The company said it was sticking by its forecast of a double-digit percentage rise in full-year profit.
